generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can become invalid after freeze when later material writes outlive its certificate, and a focused successful gate can mask a canonical repository gate that still rejects the final source bytes.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Publish readiness before the final material write, or treat focused behavioral evidence as equivalent to the repository-wide canonical source gate.
trigger_signals: canonical formatter rejects final source bytes
focused gate green while aggregate gate aborts early

reusable_control.procedure: Bind every readiness certificate to the last material write and require canonical source gates to discriminate the same material bytes; pending remote state remains pending.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Do not publish terminal readiness until all intended material writes are complete, and never substitute a focused gate for the canonical repository source contract.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Recompute parent/path identity after publication and use exact formatter-produced bytes or an exact candidate formatter execution to distinguish source-gate regressions.

transfer_cases.evidence: A synthetic result-only publication check rejects a certificate whose parent is not the final material candidate.
A synthetic canonical-source check distinguishes exact formatter output from a focused behavioral pass.

skill_changes.change: Applied the existing result-only child and post-write refreeze contract before terminal publication.
Preserved independent exact-parent and canonical-gate checks as the required detection boundary.
